Name: Anurag Goel
Designation: Co-founder and General Partner, Cactus Partners
Bio: Anurag Goel is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Anurag is the Co-founder and General Partner at Cactus Venture Partners, an early growth stage venture firm investing in consumer and technology startups. He is also the Co-founder and Chairman of Cactus Communications, a global science technology enterprise with operations across 10 countries. Anurag has 23+ years of deep expertise across strategy, MandA, technology and AI, and corporate development. As part of corporate development, his key interest areas are strategy, people management, D2C brand building, organization design, and leadership development. Anurag started his career in Amsterdam with McKinsey and Co. Anurag graduated from the Management and Technology Program with degrees in Computer Science and Finance from The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania.
